svg.title: Bay Area business quadtree on the regions basemap — San Francisco search center
svg.desc: A point-region quadtree indexes 49,169 mapped OpenStreetMap shops and food venues across the Bay Area regions map. Any cell holding more than 100 locations splits at both midpoints into four equal rectangles, so the 1678 green leaf cells each hold at most 100 locations. Cells stay large over the Pacific, the bay and the ranges, and shrink to a fraction of a pixel in the dense retail cores of San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, San Mateo and San Jose. The green ring marks San Francisco as the search center; a proximity query starting there descends to a leaf covering only a few city blocks. The basemap is the same artwork as the sibling quadtree figure and is registered from generalized city markers, so this is a business-density teaching illustration rather than a survey map or a complete business census.

g.text: Quadtree: split cells with more than 100 mapped businesses.
